 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Demo: Wildfire Response Simulation and Optimization\n",
    "\n",
    "```\n",
    "Copyright © 2024, United States Government, as represented by the Administrator of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration. All rights reserved.\n",
    "\n",
    "The “\"Fault Model Design tools - fmdtools version 2\"” software is licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the \"License\"); you may not use this file except in compliance with the License. You may obtain a copy of the License at http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0. \n",
    "\n",
    "Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software distributed under the License is distributed on an \"AS IS\" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied. See the License for the specific language governing permissions and limitations under the License.\n",
    "```\n",
    "\n",
    "## Model Overview"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# sphinx_gallery_thumbnail_number = 11\n",
    "from fmdtools.sim import propagate\n",
    "from fmdtools.define.architecture.function import FunctionArchitectureGraph\n",
    "from fmdtools_examples.airspacelib.wildfire_response.model_environment import FireMap, FireEnvironment, FirePropagation, sim_properties\n",
    "from fmdtools_examples.airspacelib.wildfire_response.model_aircraft import FireAircraft\n",
    "from fmdtools_examples.airspacelib.wildfire_response.model_main import WildfireSim, plot_combined_response_from, double_size_p\n",
    "from fmdtools_examples.airspacelib.wildfire_response.model_main import BasePlacementProblem\n",
    "from IPython.display import HTML\n",
    "import inspect"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Fire Map/Propagation"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "`FireMap` defines the map that the fire propagates over. "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "{'grass': {'color': 'lightgreen'},\n",
       " 'forest': {'color': 'darkgreen'},\n",
       " 'scrub': {'color': 'gold'},\n",
       " 'burning': {'color': 'red', 'as_bool': True, 'alpha': 0.5},\n",
       " 'base': {'color': 'black'},\n",
       " 'to_burn': {'color': 'yellow', 'as_bool': True, 'alpha': 0.5},\n",
       " 'extinguished': {'color': 'grey'}}"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 2,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "sim_properties"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "(<Figure size 500x500 with 1 Axes>, <Axes: xlabel='x', ylabel='y'>)"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 3,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 500x500 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fm = FireMap()\n",
    "fm\n",
    "\n",
    "fm.show(sim_properties)\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "`FireMap` has a number of parameters that can be modified to simulate different types of fires:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "class FireMapParam(CoordsParam):\n",
      "    \"\"\"\n",
      "    Parameter defining the fire map.\n",
      "\n",
      "    Parameters\n",
      "    ----------\n",
      "    x_size: int\n",
      "        Number of grid cells in the x. Default is 10.\n",
      "    y_size: int\n",
      "        Number of grid cells in the y. Default is 10.\n",
      "    blocksize: float\n",
      "        Size of grid cels. Default is 5.0, or 5 kilometers.\n",
      "    base_locations: tuple\n",
      "        Locations in the grid to put a base. Default is  ((0.0, 0.0),).\n",
      "    num_strikes: int\n",
      "        Number of strikes to initiate in the grid. Default is 1.\n",
      "    map_type: str\n",
      "        Type of map, specified as \"uniform-xx\",\"split-xx-yy\", or \"xx-yy-zz\", where\n",
      "        xx, yy, and zz are \"grass\", \"forest\", or \"scrub\" fuels\n",
      "    grass_ig_time : float\n",
      "        Grass cell ignition time. Default is 50.0 minutes\n",
      "    grass_ex_time : float\n",
      "        Grass cell extinguish time. Default is 90.0 minutes.\n",
      "    scrub_ig_time : float\n",
      "        Scrub cell ignition time. Default is 75.0 minutes\n",
      "    scrub_ex_time : float\n",
      "        Scrub cell extinguish time. Default is 200.0 minutes.\n",
      "    forest_ig_time : float\n",
      "        Forest cell ignition time. Default is 100.0 minutes\n",
      "    grass_ex_time : float\n",
      "        Forest cell extinguish time. Default is 400.0 minutes.\n",
      "    \"\"\"\n",
      "\n",
      "    x_size: int = 10\n",
      "    y_size: int = 10\n",
      "    blocksize: float = 5.0  # 5 kilometers\n",
      "    base_locations: tuple = ((0.0, 0.0),)\n",
      "    num_strikes: int = 1\n",
      "    map_type: str = \"uniform-grass\"\n",
      "    grass_ig_time: float = 50.0  # 5 km every 50 timesteps (~3mph)\n",
      "    grass_ex_time: float = 90.0\n",
      "    scrub_ig_time: float = 75.0\n",
      "    scrub_ex_time: float = 200.0\n",
      "    forest_ig_time: float = 100.0\n",
      "    forest_ex_time: float = 400.0\n",
      "\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fm.p\n",
    "print(inspect.getsource(fm.p.__class__))"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The strike location is determined at the start of the simulation to be random based on the number of strikes.\n",
    "\n",
    "We can chose between a few different types of firemaps as follows:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "(<Figure size 500x500 with 1 Axes>, <Axes: xlabel='x', ylabel='y'>)"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 5,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 500x500 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fm_bi = FireMap(p={'map_type': 'split-forest-grass'})\n",
    "fm_bi.show(sim_properties)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "(<Figure size 500x500 with 1 Axes>, <Axes: xlabel='x', ylabel='y'>)"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 6,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 500x500 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fm_tri = FireMap(p={'map_type': 'forest-grass-scrub'})\n",
    "fm_tri.show(sim_properties)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "we can also add base locations:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "(<Figure size 500x500 with 1 Axes>, <Axes: xlabel='x', ylabel='y'>)"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 7,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 500x500 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fm_bases = FireMap(p={'map_type': 'forest-grass-scrub', 'base_locations': ((20, 20),( 40, 40), (20, 40), (40, 20))})\n",
    "fm_bases.show(sim_properties)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "and add more or less strike locations:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "(<Figure size 500x500 with 1 Axes>, <Axes: xlabel='x', ylabel='y'>)"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 8,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 500x500 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fm_three_strike = FireMap(p={'map_type': 'forest-grass-scrub', 'num_strikes': 3})\n",
    "fm_three_strike.show(sim_properties)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Different samples can further be drawn by changing the random seed:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "(<Figure size 500x500 with 1 Axes>, <Axes: xlabel='x', ylabel='y'>)"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 9,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 500x500 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fm_three_strike = FireMap(p={'map_type': 'forest-grass-scrub', 'num_strikes': 3}, r={'seed': 250})\n",
    "fm_three_strike.show(sim_properties)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Propagation of the fire is called from `FirePropagation`. "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "firepropagation FirePropagation\n",
       "- t=Time(time=-0.1, timers={})\n",
       "- s=FirePropagationState(perc_burned=0.0, leading_edge_length=0)\n",
       "- fireenvironment=FireEnvironment(c=(), ga=())"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 10,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fp = FirePropagation(track='all', fireenvironment=FireEnvironment(c={'p': {'map_type': 'forest-grass-scrub', 'num_strikes': 3}}))\n",
    "fp"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 500x500 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig, ax = fp.fireenvironment.c.show(properties=sim_properties)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Below we simulate and visualize the propagation of the fire over time:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 12,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "res, hist = propagate.nominal(fp, protect=False)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "metadata": {
    "tags": [
     "skip-execution"
    ]
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 600x400 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ani = fp.fireenvironment.c.animate(hist.fireenvironment.c, properties=sim_properties)\n",
    "# HTML(ani.to_jshtml())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Aircraft \n",
    "\n",
    "Aircraft fly from bases to mitigate the fire. They are defined in the `Aircraft` module.class"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 14,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "fe = FireEnvironment(c={\"p\": {\"base_locations\": ((40.0, 20.0),), \"num_strikes\": 3}})\n",
    "fe.prop_time()\n",
    "a1 = FireAircraft(s={'goal_x': 30, 'goal_y': 40}, fireenvironment=fe, track=\"all\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Below we simulate the aircraft responding to a (non-propagating) fire:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 15,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 600x400 with 4 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res, hist = propagate.nominal(a1, protect=False)\n",
    "fig, ax = hist.plot_line('s.fuel_status', 's.x', 's.y', 'm.mode')"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "As shown above, the aircraft alternates between flying, mitigating, and resupplying, and resupply can take some time."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 16,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 500x500 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig, ax = a1.fireenvironment.c.show_from(10, hist.fireenvironment.c, properties=sim_properties)\n",
    "hist2 = hist.cut(10, newcopy=True)\n",
    "hist2.plot_trajectory('s.x', 's.y', fig=fig, ax=ax)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 17,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 500x500 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig, ax = a1.fireenvironment.c.show_from(20, hist.fireenvironment.c, properties=sim_properties)\n",
    "hist2 = hist.cut(20, newcopy=True)\n",
    "hist2.plot_trajectory('s.x', 's.y', fig=fig, ax=ax)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 18,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 500x500 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig, ax = a1.fireenvironment.c.show_from(45, hist.fireenvironment.c, properties=sim_properties)\n",
    "hist2 = hist.cut(45, newcopy=True)\n",
    "hist2.plot_trajectory('s.x', 's.y', fig=fig, ax=ax)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Combined Simulation"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 19,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "mdl = WildfireSim()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "This integrated model has both firepropagation as well as aircraft. We can change the number of aircraft by changing the number of bases."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 20,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "(<Figure size 1200x1000 with 1 Axes>, <Axes: >)"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 20,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1200x1000 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "mdl_graph = FunctionArchitectureGraph(mdl)\n",
    "mdl_graph.draw()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 21,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 400x400 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "mdl2 = WildfireSim(p = {'firemapparam': {'base_locations': ((30, 30), (40, 40))}})\n",
    "mdl2_graph = FunctionArchitectureGraph(mdl2)\n",
    "mdl2_pos = {'wildfiresim.flows.fireenvironment': [-0.07, 0.05], 'wildfiresim.fxns.aircraft_0': [0.58, -0.62], 'wildfiresim.fxns.aircraft_1': [-0.65, -0.65], 'wildfiresim.fxns.firepropagation': [-0.02, 0.71]}\n",
    "mdl2_graph.set_pos(**mdl2_pos)\n",
    "fig, ax = mdl2_graph.draw(figsize=(4,4))\n",
    "fig.savefig(\"outputs_demo_wildfire/response_structure.svg\", bbox_inches='tight')"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 22,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# %matplotlib qt5\n",
    "# mdl2_graph.move_nodes()\n",
    "# %matplotlib inline"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Below we simulate the combined propagation and suppression of the fire"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 23,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "p = {'firemapparam': {**double_size_p, **{'num_strikes': 3, 'base_locations': ((0, 45),), 'map_type': 'forest-grass-scrub'}}}\n",
    "mdl = WildfireSim(p = p)\n",
    "res, hist = propagate.nominal(mdl, protect=False)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 24,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 500x500 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig, ax = plot_combined_response_from(20, history=hist, mdl=mdl)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 25,
   "metadata": {
    "tags": [
     "skip-execution"
    ]
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 600x400 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ani = hist.animate(plot_combined_response_from, mdl=mdl)\n",
    "# HTML(ani.to_jshtml())"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "#### Optimization\n",
    "\n",
    "We can perform optimization by defining a problem to solve. Below the problem is to minimize burned area with a single base placement given random strikes."
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "code",

     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "psp = BasePlacementProblem(track='all', p={'firemapparam': {'num_strikes': 4}}, seed=1)\n",
    "psp.perc_burned(10, 10)"
